Alex slips on a mysterious golden ring and awakens an ancient succubus curse that turns every orgasm into a permanent step toward becoming a voluptuous slut. Now he stands trembling before the mirror, watching his body soften and feminize. Longer hair, budding breasts, widening hips—while fighting the growing, irresistible urge to surrender completely.

Hi, this is the first time I'm drawing hentai (and a comic). I'm just here purely for fun and because it's been a while since anything I consumed tickled me to my liking, so I went "fuck it, i'll do it myself". I'm just an artist as a hobby so don't expect any professional lineart or coloring, really I only take an hour a day to progress this comic before going to bed.

You can find me in x.com/sakkiuwu
